name: OpenWeather
summary: OpenWeather gives current weather, forecasts, air quality and place lookups for any location through a keyed API.

free_plan_covers.note: The Free plan allows 60 calls a minute and 1,000,000 a month for current weather, the 5 day forecast, air pollution, maps and place lookups. The One Call API is billed separately, with the first 1,000 calls a day free.

first_paid_usd_month.note: The Startup plan is $40 a month for 600 calls a minute and 10 million a month, and adds the 16 day daily forecast. The One Call API is pay per call instead, at $0.0015 a call after the free 1,000 a day.

portability.note: Weather data is much the same everywhere, but the addresses, field names and units are OpenWeather's own, so switching services means rewriting the code that reads it.

official_api.note: OpenWeather documents and sells the API itself, with published plans and limits.

needs_api_key.note: Every call must include your API key (appid); requests without one are refused.

setup.step: Sign up at openweathermap.org; your API key arrives in the confirmation email and is also on your account page.

builder_notes: Call OpenWeather from server code and keep OPENWEATHER_API_KEY out of the browser.
Cache each location's weather for several minutes so many visitors share one call and the app stays under 60 calls a minute.
